sloka: स तौ महात्मा गज मन्द गामि शखा मृगः तत्र चिरन् चरन्तौ ।दृष्ट्वा विषादम् परमम् जगाम चिन्ता परीतो भय भार मग्नः ॥४-१-१२९॥
transliteration: sa tau mahātmā gaja manda gāmi śakhā mṛgaḥ tatra ciran carantau ।dṛṣṭvā viṣādam paramam jagāma cintā parīto bhaya bhāra magnaḥ ॥4-1-129॥

translations.english: The great soul, Sugriva, walking slowly like an elephant saw both of them and became despondent, worried and immersed in fear.
